data.title: Registered Nurse
data.summary: A fixed-term outpatient nursing role covering care needs assessments, non-urgent appointments, patient office work and on-call shifts. Patients of different ages are served in person, by phone and through digital services.

requirements.question: Is Finnish needed from day one, or could someone start in English and build up Finnish on the job?
requirements.why: The posting requires fluent Finnish for successful performance in the role.

requirements.text: Stress tolerance, flexibility and a proactive work attitude
requirements.question: What does 'a proactive work attitude' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting values a proactive attitude, stress tolerance and flexibility without giving concrete examples.
